name: UTOPIA PLANITIA — Zhurong landing site

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 114 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Northern lowland plain, mantled and very flat.

blurb: Northern lowland plain, mantled and very flat — and the same basin Viking 2 set down in 45 years earlier.

metrics.signature: plant → push hard → sink → rearward slip → delayed high extraction
flat plant → gradual load → controlled sink → vertical extraction → short forward swing
